test_vectorize: test the vectorized_func to verify numpy broadcasting with scalar and array inputs
test_vectorize_fortran_order: test vectorized_func with Fortran-ordered arrays to verify column-major broadcasting behavior
test_type_selection: test selective_func to verify numpy dtype-based type dispatch for int, float, and complex
test_trivial_broadcasting: test vectorized_is_trivial to determine if broadcasting is trivial for given array shapes
test_passthrough_arguments: test vec_passthrough to verify non-vectorized arguments are passed through unchanged
test_method_vectorization: test VectorizeTestClass.method to verify numpy array vectorization on class methods
test_array_collapse: test vectorized_func to verify scalar output collapse for zero-dimensional inputs
test_vectorized_noreturn: test add_to to verify vectorized in-place modification of NonPODClass instances
